title: Regions and zones
summary: A region is a geographic area. A zone is a deployment area within a region. Some resources are zonal, regional or global.
introduction: A region is a geographic area. A zone is a deployment area within a region. Some resources are zonal, regional or global. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.title: Regions and zones

blocks.text: The correct location field depends on the resource. A VM and an object-storage bucket do not use location settings in exactly the same way.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Classify a planned VM as a zonal resource.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not assume every service uses a zone field.
For more detail later, use this [Google Cloud Platform further reading](https://cloud.google.com/docs/overview).
